name: Diana, Duskstalker's On Enter: becomes distant (level-up)
notes: Same level-up-bypass approach as diana-deadly-duelist-enter-materialize-bullet: CanChampionLevelUpIntoCard only checks the CURRENT champion's own printed CardLevel, not lineage, so the starting champion's CardID is patched directly to Diana, Deadly Duelist (level 2) as the level-up precondition, then a real level-up (via the standard MaterializeChoice flow, offered as one of the usual material-zone choices) into Diana, Duskstalker (level 3) fires her On Enter trigger naturally (BecomeDistant($player, $mzID), GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities['iq4d5vettc:0']). Only the On Enter half is covered; her On Champion Hit trigger (generating a Creeping Torment curse card) requires a real combat hit and is out of scope.
